reason: The statement materially misreports validated dependency 1.3.2.2: it says that dependency 'asserts block-product and norm identities after the zero-padding construction', whereas 1.3.2.2 retains only the ambient identity A_0B=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger X) and explicitly states that no square-zero-padding norm identity (in particular ||E_{11} tensor z||=||z||) follows, withdrawing the compressed-product/norm bridge. Amend this clause to say that 1.3.2.2 supplies only the ambient block-product identity and supplies no corner membership or norm identification. The negative compatibility conclusion may then remain, but it is not valid to certify a node that falsely characterizes a cited validated dependency.
